task: Odd-only bit-packed prime sieve plus 64-bit gcd/modPow/isPrime/factorize with time-bounded tests
reasoning_summary: Wrote tests first with literal published prime counts, strong-pseudoprime cases, BigInteger cross-checks and 2 s time bounds. Implemented an odd-only long[] sieve with prefix popcounts for countUpTo/nth, and Math.multiplyHigh-based mulMod with deterministic Miller-Rabin and Pollard rho. All 27 tests passed on the first run.
